candidates.change_summary: Modify nonReentrant_ modifier to skip setting locked_ back to false after function body, leaving contract permanently locked once entered.
Change the assignment of acc.unlockTime so that it always sets to the provided _unlockTime (even if it's in the past), instead of max(_unlockTime, block.timestamp).
Remove updating acc.balance when depositing, so Put does not increase stored balance though it still logs the deposit.

Replace the external call to msg.sender.call{value: _am}("") with a transfer-style state change first: subtract balance before making the external call (moves the sub_uint256 update to before the call), which can change behavior if the call re-enters or fails.
Change the external call so that it uses revert on failure instead of conditional success handling: require the call succeeded, causing different observable behavior when the transfer fails.
Modify the nonReentrant_ modifier to not reset the lock after the function (remove unlocking), causing subsequent Collect calls to revert and thus changing observable behavior.
